Pabna was freed 2 days after country's victory
2014-12-18T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Pabna
https://www.thedailystar.net/pabna-was-freed-2-days-after-countrys-victory-55864

Although the country achieved its victory on Pakistan occupation forces on December 16, Pabna was freed on this day in 1971. The freedom fighters on December 18 hoisted the national flag on Pabna deputy commissioner office. The freedom fighters fought against the occupation army till December 15. The Pakistan troops took shelter in different areas till December 17. They also put up barricades so that the freedom fighters cannot enter the district headquarters, said local freedom fighters. “The Pakistan occupation army remained holed up at Wapda offices in Pabna Sadar and Ishwardi upazilas on December 16. When the freedom fighters tried to enter the district headquarters on December 16, the Pak army barricaded the Pabna-Ishwardi highway,” said Baby Islam, a valiant freedom fighter. The Pakistan army surrendered on December 18 to the joint forces and started leaving Pabna. Then freedom fighters from different areas entered the district town and hoisted the flag, he said. Gruesome mass killings took place at Sagarkandi, Demra, Gopalnagar, Hadal and Handial areas. 'Durjoy Pabna', a liberation war memorial was later built on the premises of Pabna deputy commissioner office to pay tribute to the martyrs of the district.
